integrity: Exact integer polynomial checks are supplied in CHECKER.py. The analytic jet-rank proof, not finite numerical experiments, establishes the infinite small-time assertions. Published-source comparisons are limited to inspected material.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the finite symmetric sections of three, five, and seven quadratic-dispersion modes and the exact quadratic trajectory. The asymptotic comparison constants depend on the fixed nonzero curvature and no uniformity, general trajectory result, all-section theorem, or optimal multiplicative asymptotic constant is claimed. Implicit older coverage remains possible.
title: An exceptional parabolic curvature changes seven-mode Fourier observability by two powers
